limitations: History counts describe recorded evidence, not total latent bugs or engineering effort.
Native shell exit counts and qa_check exits overlap; never sum them. Multi-command shell final exit can hide an earlier failed qa_check.
Native adaptive paths retain original original-private-evidence source location; valid preserved output and accounting evidence now reside under corrected root.
Expected denied API requests, test negative subprocesses and intentional startup loading are not defects. No requirement for zero 4xx responses.
Source-only original diagnoses are not mislabeled as executed original failures.
Fresh independent gates were blocked/pending inside builders; post-freeze evaluators are separate evidence.
public_normalization: Private paths/native identities and random check record UUIDs omitted; owner/check_id/phase/exit_code and source trace ordinals retained. Final out-of-sample evidence linked after historical reconciliation.
